spec.description: Unshaded upright concave heptagon with a rectangular stem, horizontal shoulders and two sloping roof edges. No measurements, labels or angle marks are supplied.
spec.mathematics: Seven vertices; two reflex shoulder angles of 270 degrees, two roof-base angles of 45 degrees, and three angles of 90 degrees. Coordinates reconstruct the displayed shape without introducing printed measurements.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied tile outline only; no tessellation is shown.

answer.short: Sample arrangement: alternate upright and inverted copies in interlocking rows, then repeat the rows to cover a rectangle at least $15\text{ cm}\times10\text{ cm}$ without gaps or overlaps.
answer.worked: Trace and cut out the arrow-shaped heptagon. Rotate another copy through $180^{\circ}$ and fit its point between two upright copies. Continue alternating upright and inverted copies, then translate the arrangement to make adjoining rows. Extend the pattern across a rectangle at least $15\text{ cm}\times10\text{ cm}$, allowing tiles to extend beyond its boundary. The matching edges fit without gaps or overlaps; at each interior meeting point the angles total $360^{\circ}$.
